analysis_lanes.deployment_evidence: strict retained-only checkpoint replay and hash audit
analysis_lanes.oracle_only: held-out data used only after checkpoint freeze; nondeployable and excluded from training

method.sampling: exact Phase3GSequenceDataset RNG replay; stress manifest excluded
method.historical_expert_warning: projection target is the old P3 expert, not an acoustic capacity oracle

positive_control.description: same architecture when path 8 is present during training

historical_oracle_correction.method: least-squares projection of the old full-P3 path expert into the retained expert+dictionary bank

free_2048_tap_fir.interpretation: best found by three registered non-convex initializations; failure to pass is not an impossibility or memory-capacity proof

evidence.memory_reason: not opened: same 2048/4096/240/hidden32 architecture passes the known-path positive control

hypothesis_disposition.training_coverage_or_dictionary: supported: the retained bank acoustic oracle misses the P1 rebound gate, while all three known-path controls pass with the same memory, FIR length, update period, and hidden size
hypothesis_disposition.conditional_mapping: secondary, not selected: a 240-sample coefficient oracle does not improve over the static retained bank, so remapping the current bank alone has no demonstrated upper-bound margin
hypothesis_disposition.routing: not the sole cause: deployed alpha is close to the calibration-selected bank alpha and the proxy choices are stable rather than random
hypothesis_disposition.memory: rejected for this phase: known-path controls pass with the unchanged 4096-sample history
hypothesis_disposition.simple_ir_coverage: not independently supported across eight folds; the selected intervention therefore targets multi-space training coverage and learned dictionary support, not time-domain nearest IR alone

selected_correction.name: coverage_balanced_three_neighbor_synthesis
selected_correction.single_change: Replace second=self.nearest[first] with uniform sampling over the three closest retained paths under the mean rank of aligned-IR, 50-8000 Hz secondary-response, and primary-template distances.

frozen_hyperparameters.distance: mean within-fold rank of aligned IR, complex S response, and complex P template
